briefdescription.para: A type for holding instructions and their stride descriptors.
A wrapper around ScalarEvolution, used to add runtime SCEV checks.

detaileddescription.para: Simplifies SCEV expressions in the context of existing SCEV assumptions. The interleaved access analysis can also add new predicates (for example by versioning strides of pointers).

briefdescription.para: True if the loop may contain non-reversed interleaved groups with out-of-bounds accesses.

detaileddescription.para: We ensure we don't speculatively access memory out-of-bounds by executing at least one scalar epilogue iteration.

briefdescription.para: Holds the relationships between the members and the interleave group.
Holds dependences among the memory accesses in the loop.

detaileddescription.para: It maps a source access to a set of dependent sink accesses.

briefdescription.para: Analyze the interleaved accesses and collect them in interleave groups.

detaileddescription.para: Substitute symbolic strides using Strides. Consider also predicated loads/stores in the analysis if EnableMaskedInterleavedGroup is true.

briefdescription.para: Invalidate groups, e.g., in case all blocks in loop will be predicated contrary to original assumption.

detaileddescription.para: Although we currently prevent group formation for predicated accesses, we may be able to relax this limitation in the future once we handle more complicated blocks. Returns true if any groups were invalidated.

briefdescription.para: Check if Instr belongs to any interleave group.
Get the interleave group that Instr belongs to.

simplesect.para: nullptr if doesn't have such group.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if an interleaved group that may access memory out-of-bounds requires a scalar epilogue iteration for correctness.
Invalidate groups that require a scalar epilogue (due to gaps).

detaileddescription.para: This can happen when optimizing for size forbids a scalar epilogue, and the gap cannot be filtered by masking the load/store.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if we have any interleave groups.
Create a new interleave group with the given instruction Instr, stride Stride and alignment Align.
Release the group and remove all the relationships.
Do everything necessary to release the group, apart from removing it from the InterleaveGroups set.

memberdef.argsstring: (MapVector< Instruction *, StrideDescriptor > &AccessStrideInfo, const DenseMap< Value *, const SCEV * > &Strides)
memberdef.name: collectConstStrideAccesses

briefdescription.para: Collect all the accesses with a constant stride in program order.
Returns true if BB is a predicated block.
Returns true if LoopAccessInfo can be used for dependence queries.
Returns true if memory accesses A and B can be reordered, if necessary, when constructing interleaved groups.

detaileddescription.para: A must precede B in program order. We return false if reordering is not necessary or is prevented because A and B may be dependent.

briefdescription.para: Collect the dependences from LoopAccessInfo.

detaileddescription.para: We process the dependences once during the interleaved access analysis to enable constant-time dependence queries.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if Stride is allowed in an interleaved group.
Drive the analysis of interleaved memory accesses in the loop.

detaileddescription.para: Use this class to analyze interleaved accesses only when we can vectorize a loop. Otherwise it's meaningless to do analysis as the vectorization on interleaved accesses is unsafe.
The analysis collects interleave groups and records the relationships between the member and the group in a map.
